# MBMS Podcast Studio

> MBMS Podcast Studio is a two-person podcast studio based in Marlow, Buckinghamshire, UK, run by Damien and Peter Bidmead. We make, distribute and market podcasts for businesses: plan and coach, record (in a London studio, at the client's place or remotely), edit and transcribe, distribute in video and audio to every major platform, turn each episode into shorts and a monthly content calendar, and grow the show's YouTube channel. Clients can pick one service or all six.

Damien has more than 15 years in marketing, agency-side and in-house, across B2B software, cybersecurity, insurance technology, healthcare, fintech, martech, FMCG, retail and video games. Peter leads YouTube and social growth, organically and without paid ads. We record at Great Portland Street Studio in London, bring a RØDE mobile studio to clients' offices and events in Marlow, the Thames Valley, London and beyond, and record remote guests with Riverside. We use our own apps, Offcuts (clips, captions and covers from each episode) and Post Desk (a month of posts laid out ready to publish). We don't offer paid advertising.

## Services and guide prices

1. Plan and coach: show format, episode and guest planning, coaching and feedback. Included in the pilot episode, or quoted on its own
2. Record: recording session £250 for up to 90 minutes, including preparation, sound check, monitoring and raw files. Studio, mobile (we come to you) or remote
3. Edit and transcribe: audio editing from £175 per episode; audio and video editing from £350; edited transcripts from £85; show notes and descriptions from £95
4. Distribute: video and audio on YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music and the other major apps, uploaded and scheduled. Quoted per show; included in the complete episode package
5. Shorts and a monthly content calendar: clips, captions and covers made with Offcuts, laid out in Post Desk. Clips from an existing YouTube podcast: 5 clips from £195 per episode, 10 clips from £345, monthly clips (up to 20 a month) from £595 a month
6. YouTube channel growth: titles, thumbnails, descriptions, playlists and Shorts that lead back to full episodes. Quoted per channel

Packages: pilot episode from £750; complete episode package (recording, editing, show notes, distribution and three social clips) from around £950 per episode; monthly packages tailored; the full podcast package (all six services) tailored. Prices are guidelines, not fixed rates.

## Our podcast

- The Podcast Pivot: a short, sharp show for founders, marketers and business owners thinking about a podcast, or who already have one and aren't getting what they hoped for. Listen on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/57sq8LLsrorHbcUvYFdcgx or Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-pod-pivot/id6817449302
